_comment: Lineage for every artefact the real run stores. Extraction lineage is what lets a reviewer re-check a fact without re-running the research, and what makes AF-9 decidable.

material_kind.description: Raw and derived material are never conflated: rendered_html is what the browser produced, provider_extracted is what the vendor returned as text, raw_response is the unparsed transport body.

parent_ids.description: Empty for a directly retrieved artefact. A derived artefact names the artefact(s) it was derived from, so the chain is walkable to a retrieval.

derivation.description: A 'judged' artefact is model output and is never evidence of a source fact.

source_grade.description: Assigned by the published rubric, not by the producer.

retrieval_decision.description: The egress decision that permitted this retrieval, so an audit can tell a governed fetch from an ungoverned one.

challenge_suspected.description: True when the guard saw challenge markers. Such an artefact may be stored for diagnosis but may never be cited by an accepted row (AF-3).

validated.description: Storage is never business validation. A row becomes reviewed only through the human review step.
